εἴπῃσθα: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. subj. 2 sg., epic -ῃσθα (= Attic εἴπῃς), in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’you may tell’ · also aor. subj. 2 sg. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα, continued by ἀτάρ: ’and (that) you may tell’
θήλειαι: θῆλυς — female; adj., fem. nom. pl. (ἵπποι ... θήλειαι ’mares’)
κάλλεος: κάλλος — beauty; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κάλλους), with εἵνεκα: ’on account of beauty’
κατακτείνῃ: κατακτείνω — kill; aor. subj. 3 sg., after εἰς ὅ κε: ’until he kills’
κερτομίας: κερτομία — taunt, mockery, gibe; fem. acc. pl.
κεχαρισμένα: χαρίζομαι — oblige, gratify; perf. part. pass. neut. acc. pl., used as an adj.: ’agreeable, kindly’
κυανοχαίτῃ: κυανοχαίτης — dark-haired (epithet of Poseidon, from κύανος ’dark blue-black’ + χαίτη ’flowing hair’); masc. dat. sg.
παντοῖοι: παντοῖος — of every kind, of all sorts; masc. nom. pl.
ἀγαλλόμεναι: ἀγάλλω — glorify; mid. exult, glory (in); pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl.: ’exulting’ (+ dat., in something)
ἀλλοτρίων: ἀλλότριος — belonging to another, not one’s own; masc./neut. gen. pl., as a noun: ’of what is another’s’
ἀνηρείψαντο: ἀνερείπομαι — snatch up and carry away; aor. 3 pl., augment inside the compound (ἀν-ηρείψαντο, ε lengthened to η)
ἀπαμείβετο: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἀπημείβετο)
ἁλοσύδνης: Ἁλοσύδνη — Halosydne, an epithet-name for a sea-goddess (usually identified with Amphitrite), whose formation and exact meaning are uncertain; fem. gen. sg., kept as a proper name
ἰοῦσαι: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’going’
ἴδες: ὁράω — see; aor. 2 sg., from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδες, unaugmented): ’you saw’
ὄψει: ὁράω — see; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic -ει (= Attic ὄψῃ) · also ὄψις — sight, the eyes; fem. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with the eyes’ (ὄψει … ἐσίδεσκεν ’looked with her eyes’)
ᾤκεον: οἰκέω — dwell, inhabit; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic ᾤκουν): ’they lived’
